Package com.framed.streamer.dispatcher

Record Class CountingDispatcher.Snapshot

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.framed.streamer.dispatcher.CountingDispatcher.Snapshot
Record Components:
received - datapoints handed to CountingDispatcher.push(com.framed.io.dispatch.DataPoint<?>)
dropped - datapoints the bounded push queue could not accept
handlerErrors - messages that failed to parse before reaching the queue
perChannel - received count per channel identifier, ordered by identifier
wallElapsedMillis - wall-clock span between the first and last push
achievedHz - received divided by wallElapsedMillis, in datapoints/s
meanLatencyMillis - mean emit→sink latency
p50LatencyMillis - median emit→sink latency
p95LatencyMillis - 95th-percentile emit→sink latency
p99LatencyMillis - 99th-percentile emit→sink latency
maxLatencyMillis - largest observed emit→sink latency
Enclosing class:
CountingDispatcher
public static record CountingDispatcher.Snapshot(long received, long dropped, long handlerErrors, Map<String,Long> perChannel, long wallElapsedMillis, double achievedHz, double meanLatencyMillis, long p50LatencyMillis, long p95LatencyMillis, long p99LatencyMillis, long maxLatencyMillis) extends Record
Immutable view of one measurement run.

      public final boolean equals(Object o)
      Indicates whether some other object is "equal to" this one. The objects are equal if the other object is of the same class and if all the record components are equal. Reference components are compared with Objects::equals(Object,Object); primitive components are compared with '=='.
